decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with Mox Diamond and land destruction effects like Armageddon and Wasteland, while also utilizing Terravore as a powerful aggro threat. The deck aims to disrupt opponent's mana base, while also maintaining card advantage with Sylvan Library and efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares. The inclusion of cards like Mother of Runes and Sylvan Safekeeper provide protection for key threats, allowing the deck to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of land destruction and efficient beatdown strategies.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Phyrexian Dreadnought combo with Stifle to counter any potential triggers that would prevent it from entering the battlefield, allowing for a powerful 12/12 creature for only one mana. The rest of the deck is filled with efficient card draw and counterspells to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ensuring a fast and explosive win.

The main focus of this deck is to lock down the opponent's board and prevent them from mounting any significant threats. It utilizes cards like Propaganda and Back to Basics to slow down the opponent's attacks, while also using cards like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide to control the board. The deck also includes cards like Solitary Confinement and Aura of Silence to protect itself while setting up its win condition, which involves using cards like Opalescence and Replenish to overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the strategy revolves around disruption and control to secure the win.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to generate value and outlast opponents while using Survival of the Fittest to find key creature cards. It includes a mix of utility creatures, card advantage engines, and mana acceleration to support the game plan. The goal is to establish a board presence that is difficult for the opponent to overcome, while also having the flexibility to disrupt their strategy with counter spells and removal. The deck aims to control the pace of the game and win through incremental advantage and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping mana with cards like Fyndhorn Elves, Llanowar Elves, and Gaea's Cradle to bring out powerful elves like Priest of Titania and Multani's Acolyte. It utilizes Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to untap elves and generate even more mana. The deck can also generate card advantage with cards like Survival of the Fittest and Squee, Goblin Nabob while maintaining a steady board presence. With cards like Biorhythm and Tribal Forcemage, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with a swarm of elves and win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a powerful enchantress engine and generate a large amount of card advantage. The key strategy involves using enchantress creatures like Argothian Enchantress to draw cards whenever you cast enchantments, while utilizing cards like Replenish and Sterling Grove to recur key enchantments from your graveyard. The deck also aims to lock down the board with enchantments like Elephant Grass and Parallax Wave, while threatening a win condition with cards like Opalescence and Words of War. The mana base is designed to support the enchantress engine with a mix of mana acceleration lands like Serra's Sanctum and efficient color-fixing lands like City of Brass.

The main focus of this Mono Blue Control deck is to establish control of the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan using counterspells, bounce effects, and removal spells. The deck aims to control the pace of the game through cards like Chain of Vapor, Counterspell, and Parallax Tide while maintaining card advantage with Fact or Fiction and Impulse. Standstill provides additional card advantage while also deterring opponents from playing spells. The deck also includes some win conditions like Masticore and Mishra's Factory to close out the game once control has been established.

This deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyrokinesis while also using Oath of Druids to bring out powerful creatures like Bloodfire Colossus. The deck also includes burn spells like Fireblast and Sulfuric Vortex to apply pressure to the opponent. Pyrostatic Pillar helps to disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Naturalize and Gaea's Blessing provide additional utility. Overall, the deck looks to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board of Elvish creatures and generating mana with cards like Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle. It also includes cards like Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures and Biorhythm to finish off the opponent by setting their life total to match the number of creatures on the battlefield. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive Elf tribal deck while utilizing powerful synergy and card advantage to maintain pressure and close out the game swiftly.

This Aggro Goblin deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of Goblin creatures, leveraging their tribal synergy and efficient cost to deal large amounts of damage in a short amount of time. Key cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief help accelerate the deck's aggressive strategy, while cards like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander provide additional firepower to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes some disruption with cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize to handle opposing threats and maintain the tempo of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through various disruption spells and removal, while utilizing Oath of Druids as a win condition to quickly bring out powerful creatures. The deck also includes various utility cards such as Sylvan Library and Zur's Weirding to control card advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's requirements, with a mix of lands and mana rocks to ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck aims to maintain board control and efficiently bring out threats to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive low-cost creatures and burning spells to deal direct damage to the opponent, aiming to win the game before the opponent can establish a strong board presence. By maximizing direct damage spells and aggressive creatures, it creates a fast-paced and relentless strategy that puts pressure on the opponent to quickly find answers or face defeat. The inclusion of cards like Grim Lavamancer, Jackal Pup, and Lightning Bolt allows for consistent early game pressure, while Fireblast and Ball Lightning provide potent finishers to close out the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards to access key combo pieces such as Replenish and Opalescence. By using cards like Frantic Search, Careful Study, and Attunement, the deck aims to fill the graveyard with powerful enchantments like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide. Once the graveyard is set up, the player can cast Replenish to bring back multiple enchantments at once, turning them into powerful creatures with Opalescence. This deck aims to control the board while setting up its combo win condition.

The deck revolves around using Tinker to assemble a combo involving Phyrexian Devourer and Fling to deal massive damage to the opponent in a single turn. It includes cards like Altar of Dementia and Gaea's Blessing to support the combo, while also including control elements like Defense Grid and Seal of Cleansing to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Mox Diamond to power out its key pieces quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countermagic and removal spells while using Standstill to draw cards and stall the opponent. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan, maintain board presence with lands that can become creatures, and win through card advantage and efficient removal. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's plans, control the board, and outlast the opponent until you can generate enough resources to close out the game.

The main goal of this deck is to control the game through various forms of removal and hand disruption, while also utilizing Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures and set up powerful combos. By using Goblin Welder to recur important artifacts and creatures, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent in the mid to late game. The inclusion of Burning Wish allows for additional versatility and the ability to access silver bullet answers from the sideboard, making it a potent and adaptable control deck in the premodern format.
